about: Saturday night at the PixelPlex (docs/CINEMA_PLAN.md): the films the cinema shows, one a week, the strands taking turns. Every author died more than 70 years ago (public domain in Israel and the US); the worker finds the text on Project Gutenberg through Gutendex by title and author at run time, so no ids are needed. kind: play or story. pitch: one line for the hosts, the poster and the TV guide. adventure: old adventure stories and fairy tales, from the books only (never anything from later film versions).
name: PixelPlex
